question: Do observed anthropogenic resource expansion and host-contribution architecture depart from the expectation generated by host count and host-family composition alone?
eligible_species: Host-taxonomy-lower-bound adequate butterflies with observed introduced-added WGSRPD3 units > 0 and sufficient within-family host pools.

preserve_exactly: number of hosts in each WCVP host family
null.randomization: For each focal butterfly, sample without replacement the same number of alternative HOSTS-WCVP plant species from each of its observed host families, then reconstruct native and contemporary WGSRPD3 resource unions.
null.candidate_pool: All species-level HOSTS plant taxa resolved to WCVP in the same fixed reconstruction and having valid native and contemporary WCVP footprints.

primary_statistics: Spearman(host-family breadth, maximum single-host fractional share)
species_level_diagnostic: Compare each species observed log expansion, effective contributor number and maximum single-host share with its family-composition-matched null distribution.
claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc robustness analysis motivated by manuscript review. It controls exact host count and host-family composition but does not randomize evolutionary host accessibility, observational completeness, or causal host choice.
